summary: Porsche Auto Funding LLC filed an 8-K reporting entry into material agreements for Porsche Financial Auto Securitization Trust 2026-1, an auto-loan ABS issuance. The trust issued Class A-1, A-2a, A-2b, A-3 and A-4 notes with an aggregate initial principal of $911 million on the September 30, 2026 closing date; U.S. Bank Trust Company is indenture trustee. Agreements include the indenture, purchase agreement, sale and servicing agreement, administration agreement, amended trust agreement and asset representations review agreement. This is a routine securitization takedown, not a special situation; no board recommendation, equity premium or deal terms apply.
